channel.title: The Western Producer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Oat Mafia pushes for big increase in U.S. acres
item.description: The Oat Mafia is trying to boost U.S. oat acres but an oat industry analyst thinks that is going to be a tall task.

item.title: Shares slump, bonds skid as oil surge threatens inflation shock
item.description: Wall Street opened lower Monday as the inflationary jolt from surging oil prices threatened to raise living costs and interest rates around the globe, while investors desperate for liquidity fled to the U.S. dollar.

item.title: International tractor manufacturer carries on post-split
item.description: Despite the dissolution of a key joint venture, the world’s largest-selling farm tractor company by volume says a new product lineup will be rolling out over 2026 and 2027.

item.title: Sencor crop protection products now available from SipCam Agro Canada
item.description: Sipcam Agro announced a new commercial agreement that gives the company the exclusive rights to sell and distribute Sencor 75 DF and Sencor 480 F herbicides in Canada. The transition was completed in partnership with Sumitomo Corporation, who acquired Sencor from Bayer in 24 countries including Canada.

item.title: New phosphate fertilizer trade corridor planned
item.description: V6 Agronomy is building a fertilizer terminal at the Port of Johnstown it hopes will be moving 480,000 tonnes of phosphate a year by the end of this decade.

item.title: Crude price may have topped says analyst
item.description: Any chance of crude oil prices skyrocketing higher became less likely on March 9, said Phil Flynn, senior market analyst at the Price Futures Group in Chicago. Flynn based that on the assumption that Iran’s military capabilities are declining quickly.

item.title: Ritchie Bros. parent to buy online auction firm BigIron
item.description: RB Global, the parent of Canadian auction firm Ritchie Bros., is further expanding its reach into the online farm auction market with a deal for Nebraska-based BigIron Auction Co.

item.title: Food industry faces packaging shift after court backs federal plastics regulation
item.description: Pressure on Canada’s agri-food sector to change packaging methods is increasing, following a Federal Court of Appeal ruling that upheld the federal government’s power to regulate plastics.

item.title: Five reasons why there are seasons
item.description: In our last article, we looked at insolation and the solar constant, and in this article, we are going to look at global net radiation and seasons.

item.title: Careful consideration urged for drone spraying
item.description: Proposed Health Canada regulations would make any pesticides available for aerial application also legal to apply by drone — and while that would remove many barriers for farmers and researchers, industry experts caution that planes and drones are different birds.
